column2: I am one of a kind.
I am happy to be me.
I am good inside and out.
I can help set the table.
I am a big kid now.
I can turn off the light.
It is okay to feel sad.
It is okay to feel mad.
I can be still and breathe.
I can say I am sad.
I can be gentle with me.
I can hug a sad friend.
I am fun to play with.
I can be a good friend.
I can sit by someone new.
I can say I missed you.
I am glad for my toys.
I am glad for my friends.
I am thankful for my hands.
I am thankful for my teacher.
I am glad I woke up.
I am lucky to be me.
I am loved no matter what.
